builders.angle: LITERAL -- work BRIEF-r45's fix list 1 to 4 in order and exactly as written, one wing at a time, the Lampworks FIRST (the round's fight). Never fewer objects, never a smoother or tidier surface; keep every change inside your four wings.

MATERIAL FIRST -- every pale placeholder prop in the four wings (crates, sacks, crocks, block, tubs, lantern) given a real material -- grain, weave, glaze, enamel, rust, nails, stencils -- and an inked edge in its room's light, then the contact shadows, then the floors' darks, then the Hedge's projection.

GROUND THE ROOM -- the props float and the floors go milky. Give every standing object a contact shadow sized to its foot and keep each floor's darks dark and coloured, then draw the props richer in that light; fix the Hedge's stretched side-wall texture first, since three judges have named it twice.
